KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Answers a greeting with the same greeting (Hujambo? Hujambo!) instead of its reply.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child hears the greeting as a sound to echo, as with "Hello" in English; the question-and-answer pair has not been learnt.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakusalimu: "Hujambo?" Unajibu nini?" with "Hujambo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Act it as a ball game: the greeting is thrown, the reply is caught; the two words are on two different cards.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Ukiulizwa "Hujambo?" unajibu "Sijambo," maana yake sina tatizo.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets an elder with a peer or Sheng greeting (Mambo! Sasa!) instead of Shikamoo.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: Mambo and Sasa are what the child hears most among children and on the street; he has not been taught that an elder is greeted differently.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unamwona babu njiani. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Mambo babu!" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Sort picture cards of people (babu, rafiki, mwalimu) into two piles: Shikamoo and Hujambo.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu!
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Gives the elder's reply to the child's greeting the wrong way round (the elder says Shikamoo, or the child says Marahaba).

example.question: Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: Both words are heard together and the child does not yet know which belongs to the young person and which to the elder.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Role-play with a hat for the elder: only the one with the hat may say Marahaba.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mtoto anasema Shikamoo; mzee anajibu Marahaba.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses the greeting of another time of day.

example.question: Unamkuta mwalimu shuleni saa nne asubuhi. Unamsalimu vipi?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child learnt one greeting as a set phrase and uses it at every hour.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unamkuta mwalimu shuleni saa nne asubuhi. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Habari za jioni mwalimu!" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A clock or sun chart: asubuhi, mchana, jioni, usiku; the child moves the arrow and says the greeting for that time.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Salamu hufuata wakati: Habari za asubuhi mwalimu!
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a greeting when leaving, or a farewell when arriving.

example.question: Rafiki anasafiri kwenda kijijini. Unamuaga vipi?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: Greeting and farewell words are learnt on one chart and the child mixes the two columns.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Rafiki anasafiri kwenda kijijini. Unamuaga vipi?" with "Karibu sana!" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Act out a door: walk in and greet, walk out and say goodbye.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets a group with the singular greeting (Hujambo?) or answers for a group with Sijambo.

example.question: Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child knows one pair only; the plural forms hamjambo/hatujambo follow the person marker (m-, tu-), which has not been noticed.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?" with "Sijambo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Greet one child, then the whole row; show that the word changes with one or many.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "bendera" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Kila Jumatatu, wanafunzi wa Shule ya Amani hukusanyika uwanjani. Wanaimba wimbo wa taifa huku bendera ikipandishwa. Wote husimama wima kwa heshima." Neno "bendera" lina maana gani?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Kila Jumatatu, wanafunzi wa Shule ya Amani hukusanyika uwanjani. Wanaimba wimbo wa taifa huku bendera ikipandishwa. Wote husimama wima kwa heshima." Neno "bendera" lina maana gani?" with "bandari" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "bendera" ni kitambaa chenye rangi kinachowakilisha nchi.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tunaheshimu wimbo wa taifa na bendera ya nchi yetu.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Wanafunzi hukusanyika siku ya Jumatatu." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tunaheshimu wimbo wa taifa na bendera ya nchi yetu.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for.

example.question: Wimbo wa taifa ukiisha, wanafunzi watafanya nini?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Wimbo wa taifa ukiisha, wanafunzi watafanya nini?" with "Wataenda nyumbani kulala." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za kifungu: Wataenda madarasani kuanza masomo.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kuipenda na kuiheshimu nchi yetu.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Wanafunzi waliimba na bendera ikapandishwa." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuipenda na kuiheshimu nchi yetu.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.

example.question: Wanafunzi husimamaje wimbo wa taifa unapoimbwa?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi husimamaje wimbo wa taifa unapoimbwa?" with "Mimi huimba nikiwa nimeketi nyumbani." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: Husimama wima kwa heshima.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.error: Hands in the first draft with crossings and does not make a clean copy.

example.question: Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.cause: The child thinks writing ends when the words are down; the steps maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, urekebishaji, nakala safi are new.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.reveals: The question "Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?" with "nakala ya kwanza" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.help: Show the four steps as four boxes; the child ticks each one.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.feedback: Baada ya kurekebisha, andika nakala safi.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.error: Leaves out words or a whole line when copying.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.cause: The child copies letter by letter and loses his place when looking back.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.reveals: The question "Nakili: "Kenya ni nchi yetu nzuri."" with "Kenya nchi yetu nzuri." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.help: Copy phrase by phrase, moving a finger along the line; read the copy back against the original.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.feedback: Soma nakala yako na ulinganishe na ya asili.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.help: Put a finger space after every word.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU_KIFUNGU.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.error: The pronoun and the subject marker on the verb do not agree (Wao anacheza).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.cause: The child learns the pronoun as a word and the verb as a fixed form; he has not seen that the verb changes with the person.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Jaza: Wao ___ (cheza) mpira." with "anacheza" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.help: Colour the pronoun and the verb's first syllable the same colour: yeye a-, wao wa-, mimi ni-, sisi tu-, wewe u-, nyinyi m-.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.feedback: Kitendo hufuata nafsi: Wao wanacheza; Yeye anacheza. (wanacheza)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.error: Uses the one-person pronoun for many people, or the reverse.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.cause: The child has not linked the pronoun pair to one and many.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Juma na Ali wanasoma. ___ wanasoma." with "Yeye" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.help: Point at one child, then at a group, saying the right pronoun each time.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.feedback: Mtu mmoja ni yeye; watu wengi ni wao. (Wao)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.error: Thinks yeye is for a boy only and looks for another word for a girl (English he/she).

example.question: Amina anapika. Mtaje kwa neno moja: ___ anapika.

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.cause: English separates he and she; Kiswahili yeye is any one person.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Amina anapika. Mtaje kwa neno moja: ___ anapika." with "Wao" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.help: Use yeye for Amina and for Juma in the same lesson; ask the class to find the difference (there is none).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.feedback: Yeye ni mtu mmoja, mvulana au msichana. (Yeye)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.error: Repeats the pronoun of the question in the answer (Wewe unaenda wapi? Wewe ninaenda sokoni.) instead of switching to mimi.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.cause: The child copies the words he heard; changing person between speakers is new.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Mama anauliza: "Baba yuko wapi?" Unajibu:" with "Wewe yuko shambani." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.help: Ask and answer in pairs with a pointing finger: wewe points out, mimi points to the chest.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.feedback: Ukiulizwa kwa "wewe", unajibu kwa "mimi". (Yeye yuko shambani.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_YEYE_NA_.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.error: Counts y (and sometimes w) as a vowel.

example.question: Ni zipi ni irabu za Kiswahili?
example.wrong_answer: a, e, i, o, u, y

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.cause: English lessons teach that y is "sometimes a vowel"; Kiswahili has five vowels only.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.reveals: The question "Ni zipi ni irabu za Kiswahili?" with "a, e, i, o, u, y" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.help: Sort letter cards into two baskets; y and w go with the consonants.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.feedback: Kiswahili kina irabu tano tu: a, e, i, o, u.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.error: Counts a two-letter consonant (sh, ch, ny, dh) as two sounds.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.cause: The child counts letters, not sounds.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.reveals: The question "Neno "shamba" linaanza na konsonanti ngapi?" with "mbili: s na h" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.help: Say the sound alone (sh!) and show it is one sound on one card.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.feedback: "sh" ni sauti moja, ingawa ina herufi mbili.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.error: Says the English letter name for a vowel (i as "ai", e as "ii").
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.cause: English letter names were learnt alongside; the child uses them for the Kiswahili sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.reveals: The question "Irabu "i" katika neno "iko" inatamkwaje?" with "ai" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.help: Sing the Kiswahili vowel song with each vowel sound held.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.error: Mixes u and o (or i and e) in speech and writing (kuku said and written koko).

example.question: Ni lipi sahihi kwa ndege wa nyumbani anayetaga mayai?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.cause: Some Kenyan first languages have seven vowels, with sounds between u and o and between i and e; the child hears the Kiswahili vowels through them.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi kwa ndege wa nyumbani anayetaga mayai?" with "koko" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.help: Mouth shapes with a mirror: round and small for u, round and open for o.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.error: Does not tell ng' from ng (ngoma and ng'ombe start with the same sound to the child).

example.question: Ni neno lipi lina sauti ng' mwanzoni?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.cause: Ng' has no /g/ after the nasal; the child hears both as one.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti ng' mwanzoni?" with "ngoma" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.help: Say ngoma and ng'ombe with a hand on the throat: the /g/ of ngoma is felt.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.feedback: Ng'ombe: sauti ng' bila /g/; ngoma: ng yenye /g/.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA_VOKALI.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "bwana" as "buwana".
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "bwana" linasomwa vipi?" with "buwana" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Bwana Juma analima shamba la mahindi."?
example.wrong_answer: Bwana ... Juma ... analima ... shamba ... la ... mahindi.
example.correct_answer: Bwana Juma analima shamba la mahindi.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Bwana Juma analima shamba la mahindi."?" with "Bwana ... Juma ... analima ... shamba ... la ... mahindi." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 47 kwa dakika

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeona fyekeo la Bwana Juma?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeona fyekeo la Bwana Juma?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.

example.question: Andika kwa usahihi: juma na amina wanalima shambani.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: The child copies words, not sentences; the rule that a sentence and a name begin with a capital is not yet used.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Andika kwa usahihi: juma na amina wanalima shambani." with "juma na amina wanalima shambani." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Circle the first letter of each sentence and each name in a passage in red.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Sentensi na jina la mtu au mahali huanza kwa herufi kubwa.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Puts capital letters in the middle of words (JuMa, Kitabu KiKubwa).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Some capitals (K, M, S) are easier to form than the small letter, so the child uses them anywhere.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "JuMa ANakula" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Sort letter cards: capital only at the start; the rest small.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Herufi kubwa iko mwanzoni tu; nyingine ni ndogo.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Put a finger space after every word.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Makes the plural with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu -> watabu).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.cause: The child knows that wa- makes people plural and uses it for everything; the ngeli of the noun is not yet known.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "Kiatu kimechafuka" ni?" with "Wiatu wamechafuka." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Sort noun cards into ngeli families (m-wa, ki-vi, li-ma, n-n) and say each plural aloud.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Kila ngeli ina wingi wake: kitabu - vitabu, mtoto - watoto. (Viatu vimechafuka.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Changes the noun but not the verb or the word that agrees with it (Vitabu kimeanguka).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.cause: The child changes the word he was asked to change and stops there.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Andika kwa wingi: Mti umeanguka." with "Miti umeanguka." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Colour the noun prefix and the verb prefix the same; read the sentence and check every coloured part.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Sentensi nzima hubadilika: Vitabu vimeanguka. (Miti imeanguka.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Shows the plural only with a number word and leaves the noun singular (kitabu mbili).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.cause: English and some first languages keep the noun and add a number; Kiswahili changes the noun and the number agrees.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jembe moja" ni?" with "jembe mbili" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Line up two books: the child says vitabu viwili; then three: vitabu vitatu.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Nomino hubadilika pia: vitabu viwili. (majembe mawili)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Gives a noun of the n-n class a plural prefix (nyumba -> manyumba), or changes an irregular noun wrongly (jicho -> majicho).

example.question: Andika kwa wingi: Ng'ombe anakula nyasi.

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.cause: The child expects every plural to look different; n-n nouns stay the same and some li-ma nouns change their stem.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Andika kwa wingi: Ng'ombe anakula nyasi." with "Mang'ombe wanakula nyasi." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Keep a short list of the same-in-both nouns (nyumba, ndizi, kalamu) and the irregular ones (jicho - macho, jino - meno).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Baadhi ya nomino hazibadiliki, na baadhi hubadilika kwa njia yake. (Ng'ombe wanakula nyasi.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Takes the plural form for the singular (miti for one tree, vitabu for one book).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi iko katika umoja?

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.cause: The child heard the plural more often (a tree is usually among trees) and learnt it as the name.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi iko katika umoja?" with "Miti imeota." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Hold one object, then many; the child names each.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Kimoja ni kitabu; vingi ni vitabu. (Mti umeota.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.error: Says samahani when someone else is hurt by accident, where pole (sympathy) is meant.

example.question: Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: English "sorry" covers both apology and sympathy; Kiswahili separates them: samahani when I did wrong, pole when you suffer.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?" with "Samahani" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Two pictures: I stepped on your foot (samahani); you fell by yourself (pole). The child names each.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.feedback: Pole ni ya kumhurumia aliyeumia; samahani ni ya kuomba msamaha ukikosea.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: The child echoes the polite word he has just heard.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?" with "Asante" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Practise the pair with two children: one gives, one thanks, the giver answers Karibu.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.error: Asks with a bare command (Nipe maji!) without tafadhali or naomba.

example.question: Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: At home and in play the child hears short commands and copies them to adults.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?" with "Nipe maji!" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Say both versions; the child says which one makes mama want to help.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.error: Calls an adult by the bare first name without a title (Mwalimu, Mama, Baba, Bi., Bw.).

example.question: Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: Children call each other by name and carry the habit to adults.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?" with "Akinyi, njoo!" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Make title cards (Mwalimu, Mama, Babu, Daktari); the child puts one before each name.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.feedback: Mtu mzima huitwa kwa heshima: Mwalimu, Mama, Babu.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: The child echoes the word, as with greetings.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakuambia "Pole kwa kuumia." Unajibu?" with "Pole" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Act it: one child is hurt, the other says pole, the hurt one says asante.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "kusherehekea" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Mwezi wa Desemba, Baraka alisherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa. Alitimiza miaka minane. Mama alimwokea keki, na marafiki zake wakamwimbia." Neno "kusherehekea" lina maana gani?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Mwezi wa Desemba, Baraka alisherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa. Alitimiza miaka minane. Mama alimwokea keki, na marafiki zake wakamwimbia." Neno "kusherehekea" lina maana gani?" with "kusahau" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "kusherehekea" ni kufanya sherehe kwa furaha.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Siku ya kuzaliwa ni siku ya furaha ya kukumbuka tulipozaliwa.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Mama alioka keki." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Siku ya kuzaliwa ni siku ya furaha ya kukumbuka tulipozaliwa.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for.

example.question: Desemba ijayo Baraka atatimiza miaka mingapi?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Desemba ijayo Baraka atatimiza miaka mingapi?" with "miaka minane tena" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za kifungu: miaka tisa
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kufurahi pamoja na marafiki zetu.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Marafiki walimwimbia Baraka." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kufurahi pamoja na marafiki zetu.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Baraka alizaliwa mwezi gani?" with "Mimi nilizaliwa mwezi wa Machi." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Writes the tall small letters (b, d, h, k, l) short, so h looks like n.

example.question: Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: The child does not use the lines of the book: tall letters must reach the top line.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "nabari" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Write on three-line paper; the child colours the part of h that goes up.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Herufi h, k, l, b, d hupanda juu ya mstari wa kati.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Writes some small letters as big as capitals (kiti written kiTi or KITI).

example.question: Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Capitals were learnt first in pre-primary and feel safer to write.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?" with "KITI" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Compare k/K, s/S, t/T on cards; the child picks the small one for the middle of a word.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Ndani ya neno tumia herufi ndogo.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Put a finger space after every word.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T3_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Uses the people word (huyu, yule) for a thing (kiti huyu).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: Huyu was the first pointing word learnt; the child uses it for anything.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kiti ___ (kilicho mbali) ni kizuri." with "yule" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Point at a child (huyu) and at a chair (hiki); then sort pictures by the pointing word they take.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.feedback: Kitu cha ngeli ya ki-vi huonyeshwa kwa hiki; mtu huonyeshwa kwa huyu. (kile)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Uses the one-thing pointing word with a plural noun (watoto huyu).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: The child changes the noun but not the pointing word.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Watoto ___ (walio mbali) wanacheza." with "yule" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Mixes near and far pointing words (huyu for someone far away; yule for someone close).

example.question: Mtoto yuko karibu nawe. Unasema: Mtoto ___ ni rafiki yangu.

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: The child has not linked the forms to distance from the speaker.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Mtoto yuko karibu nawe. Unasema: Mtoto ___ ni rafiki yangu." with "yule" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Stand near one child and far from another; point and say huyu and yule; then swap places.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.feedback: Huyu ni karibu nami; yule ni mbali. (huyu)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mwalimu ___ (aliye mbali) anafundisha." with "hii" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (yule)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "shamba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /sh/, or do not separate it from /s/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "shamba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "samba" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Pushes a vowel into the cluster, so "vyakula" is said "viyakula".
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: In the child's first language, or in English loan habits, two consonants rarely sit together; he breaks them with a vowel.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Tamka neno "vyakula". Ni lipi sahihi?" with "viyakula" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the cluster in one beat, then the word; clap once for the cluster syllable.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: "vyakula" ina silabi vya-ku-la; hakuna irabu ya ziada.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "kipya" becomes "kipa".

example.question: Neno "kipya" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "kipya" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "kipa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "kipya". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Splits "kipya" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "kipya" lina silabi zipi?" with "k-i-p-y-a" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ki-pya.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /py/, /vy/, /sh/?" with "kalamu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "vyombo" as "viombo".
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Neno "vyombo" linasomwa vipi?" with "viombo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Fundi alitengeneza kiti kipya."?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Fundi alitengeneza kiti kipya."?" with "Fundi ... alitengeneza ... kiti ... kipya." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 49 kwa dakika

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, mpishi ameosha vyombo vyote?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_YA_PAMBIZO_KA.P.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_YA_PAMBIZO_KA.P.cause: The child has not been shown that a new idea gets a new aya.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_YA_PAMBIZO_KA.P.reveals: The question "Unaanza aya mpya lini?" with "sianzi; ninaandika kila kitu pamoja" among the options.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_YA_PAMBIZO_KA.P.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_YA_PAMBIZO_KA.P.error: Starts every sentence on a new line, as if each were an aya.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_YA_PAMBIZO_KA.P.cause: Early copying from the board was one sentence a line.

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Sort noun cards into ngeli families (m-wa, ki-vi, li-ma, n-n) and say each plural aloud.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Kila ngeli ina wingi wake: kitabu - vitabu, mtoto - watoto. (Walimu wanafundisha.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Changes the noun but not the verb or the word that agrees with it (Vitabu kimeanguka).

example.question: Andika kwa wingi: Daktari anatibu wagonjwa.

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Andika kwa wingi: Daktari anatibu wagonjwa." with "Madaktari anatibu wagonjwa." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Colour the noun prefix and the verb prefix the same; read the sentence and check every coloured part.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Sentensi nzima hubadilika: Vitabu vimeanguka. (Madaktari wanatibu wagonjwa.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Gives a noun of the n-n class a plural prefix (nyumba -> manyumba), or changes an irregular noun wrongly (jicho -> majicho).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.cause: The child expects every plural to look different; n-n nouns stay the same and some li-ma nouns change their stem.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Andika kwa wingi: Jino linauma." with "Majino yanauma." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Keep a short list of the same-in-both nouns (nyumba, ndizi, kalamu) and the irregular ones (jicho - macho, jino - meno).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Baadhi ya nomino hazibadiliki, na baadhi hubadilika kwa njia yake. (Meno yanauma.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.error: Shows the plural only with a number word and leaves the noun singular (kitabu mbili).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.cause: English and some first languages keep the noun and add a number; Kiswahili changes the noun and the number agrees.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "mpishi mmoja" ni?" with "mpishi wawili" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.help: Line up two books: the child says vitabu viwili; then three: vitabu vitatu.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.feedback: Nomino hubadilika pia: vitabu viwili. (wapishi wawili)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_SE.U.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Gives a detail of the passage as its message.

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.help: After listening, ask "Kifungu kinatufundisha nini?" and compare it with "Nini kilitokea?".

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Gives "kivuko" the meaning of a word that sounds like it.

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.reveals: The question "Neno "kivuko" katika kifungu lina maana gani?" with "kivuli" among the options.

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Makes a "sentence" that only repeats the word and shows no meaning (kivuko ni kivuko).

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Adds events that were not in the passage when retelling.

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tusiguse waya wa umeme; tuwaite watu wazima.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.
