KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.error: Puts several kiulizi (???) for a strong question.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.cause: Text messages and cartoons use many marks; the child copies them.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Je, tunavuka barabara wapi???" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.help: One question, one kiulizi; show a page from the class reader.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.error: Writes a small letter after a kikomo or kiulizi.

example.question: Ni lipi sahihi?
example.wrong_answer: Tunavuka barabara kwenye kivuko. mama alifurahi.
example.correct_answer: Tunavuka barabara kwenye kivuko. Mama alifurahi.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.cause: The child does not link the mark to the capital that follows it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Tunavuka barabara kwenye kivuko. mama alifurahi." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.help: Every kikomo is a gate: the next word starts big.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_KIULIZI.AL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.error: Uses the wrong noun-class form of the possessive (kitabu yangu for kitabu changu).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.cause: Town Kiswahili uses yangu, yako, yake for every noun; the child has not seen the ngeli agreement.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kiti ___ (cha Juma) kimevunjika." with "yake" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.help: Pair nouns and possessives by colour: kitabu changu, kiti chake, mtoto wangu.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.feedback: Kitabu changu; kiti chake: kimilikishi hufuata ngeli. (chake)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.error: Leaves the possessive singular with a plural noun (vitabu changu).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.cause: The child changes the noun and forgets the possessive.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Viatu ___ (vya Juma) ni vipya." with "chake" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.help: Change one object to many in front of the child; both words change.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.error: Uses the possessive of the wrong owner (-ake for something that is his own, -ake for many owners).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.cause: The child has not linked -angu, -ako, -ake, -etu, -enu, -ao to who owns the thing.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.reveals: The question "Watoto wana mpira. Ni mpira ___." with "wake" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.help: Hold up an object: Ni cha nani? Answer with the owner first, then the possessive.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.feedback: Mwenye kitu ni nani? Mimi: changu; yeye: chake; wao: chao. (wao)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.error: Puts the possessive before the noun (yangu kalamu), in English word order.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.cause: English puts "my" before the noun; Kiswahili puts it after.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "yake kofia" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.help: Build the phrase with cards: the noun first, then the possessive.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.feedback: Nomino kwanza, kimilikishi baadaye: kalamu yangu. (kofia yake)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKE_NA_A.V.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "dhahabu". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /dh/, or do not separate it from /z/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "dhahabu". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "zahabu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: /ch/ and /sh/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "shai" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "thelathini" becomes "telatini".

example.question: Neno "thelathini" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "thelathini" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "telatini" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "thelathini". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Splits "dhahabu" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "dhahabu" lina silabi zipi?" with "d-h-a-h-a-b-u" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: dha-ha-bu.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /dh/, /th/, /ch/?" with "mama" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "thamani" as "samani".
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "thamani" linasomwa vipi?" with "samani" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunatupa taka katika pipa la taka."?
example.wrong_answer: Tunatupa ... taka ... katika ... pipa ... la ... taka.
example.correct_answer: Tunatupa taka katika pipa la taka.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunatupa taka katika pipa la taka."?" with "Tunatupa ... taka ... katika ... pipa ... la ... taka." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 51 kwa dakika

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeokota chupa thelathini?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeokota chupa thelathini?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_MT_T6.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "thelathini" written "selasini".
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_MT_T6.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_MT_T6.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "selasini" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_MT_T6.help: Keep a list of the class's hard pairs (l/r, s/sh, z/dh, s/th); say each word slowly before writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_MT_T6.feedback: Andika "thelathini" kama linavyotamkwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_MT_T6.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NASAL.cause: The n or m before a consonant is soft and quick; the child does not hear it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NASAL.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "doo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NASAL.help: Hum the nasal before the word (mmm-bwa, nnn-dege).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NASAL.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_VOWEL.error: Writes a long vowel short, so the word changes: "saa" written "sa".

example.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kuonyesha wakati".

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_VOWEL.cause: The child hears the length but does not know it is shown by two letters.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_VOWEL.reveals: The question "Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kuonyesha wakati"." with "sa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_VOWEL.help: Clap the two vowels as two beats; compare a word with one and two vowels.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_VOWEL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NGAPO.error: Writes ng' without the apostrophe (ngombe for ng'ombe), or puts it where it does not belong (ng'oma for ngoma).

example.question: Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NGAPO.cause: Ng' and ng are two sounds; the apostrophe looks like dirt on the page to the child.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NGAPO.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?" with "ngombe" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NGAPO.help: Say ng'ombe and ngoma: the first has no g sound; mark it with the apostrophe.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_NGAPO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_JOIN_.error: Joins two words into one, or splits one word into two (kwasababu; mwana funzi).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_JOIN_.cause: In speech the words run together; the child has not seen each written apart.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_JOIN_.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nilichelewa kwasababu ya mvua." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_JOIN_.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T6_IMLA.IMLA.M3_TAH_JOIN_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.error: Writes the colour word without the sound change (kiti kieupe for kiti cheupe; nguo eupe for nguo nyeupe).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.cause: The child sticks the prefix on the stem; the sound change when ki- or n- meets the vowel (ki + eupe = cheupe) is new.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kiti ___ (-eupe)." with "kieupe" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.help: Say the joined forms slowly: ki-eupe becomes cheupe; n-eupe becomes nyeupe.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.feedback: Kiti cheupe; nguo nyeupe; mtoto mweusi. (cheupe)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.error: Gives an n-n noun the m- form of the adjective (nyumba mzuri for nyumba nzuri).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.cause: The n- prefix and its sound changes (nzuri, ndefu, nyeupe) are new to the child.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Nguo ___ (-eusi)." with "mweusi" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.help: Read pairs aloud: nyumba nzuri, kalamu ndefu, nguo nyeupe.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.error: Gives the adjective the people prefix whatever the noun (kiti mzuri).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.cause: Mzuri is the form the child hears most (mtoto mzuri) and is used everywhere.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kikombe ___ (-ekundu)." with "mwekundu" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.help: Match noun and adjective by colour: kiti kizuri, mtoto mzuri, vitu vizuri.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.error: Puts the adjective before the noun (mzuri mtoto), in English word order.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.cause: English puts the describing word first.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "nyeupe karatasi" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.help: Build with cards: noun first, then the adjective.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.error: Leaves the adjective singular with a plural noun (watoto mzuri).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.cause: The child changes the noun only.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mifuko ___ (-eusi)." with "mweusi" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.help: Change the noun to many and ask the child to change every word that goes with it.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_EUPE_EUS.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.error: Carries out only the first part of a two-step instruction.

example.question: Agizo: "Chukua kikapu, kisha uende dukani." Umefanya nini?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.cause: The child starts acting as soon as he hears the first verb and stops listening.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Chukua kikapu, kisha uende dukani." Umefanya nini?" with "anachukua kikapu tu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.help: Hold up one finger for each step while giving the instruction; the child repeats the steps before moving.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.feedback: Sikiliza agizo lote kwanza, kisha fanya hatua zote.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.error: Does the steps in the wrong order.

example.question: Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha ule chakula." Ni nini kinatangulia?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.cause: The child does the step he wants most first; the order words kwanza and kisha are not yet noticed.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha ule chakula." Ni nini kinatangulia?" with "kula chakula" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.help: Number the steps on the board with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.error: Mixes a direction or action word.

example.question: Agizo: "Weka sukari upande wa kulia wa meza." Ni kitendo kipi sahihi?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.cause: Pairs such as kulia/kushoto and juu/chini are learnt together and swapped.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Weka sukari upande wa kulia wa meza." Ni kitendo kipi sahihi?" with "anaiweka upande wa kushoto" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.help: Play "Mwalimu anasema": the teacher calls the word, the child acts it; mark the right hand with a band.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.feedback: Weka sukari upande wa kulia wa meza. maana yake ni anaiweka upande wa kulia.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.error: Gives an instruction that leaves out what to act on, or with no polite word (Lete!).

example.question: Ni agizo lipi liko wazi na lina adabu?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.cause: The child knows what he means and does not see that the listener cannot.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.reveals: The question "Ni agizo lipi liko wazi na lina adabu?" with "Lete!" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.help: The child gives the instruction to a partner, who does exactly what was said and no more.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.feedback: Agizo zuri linasema nini kifanyike, kwa kitu gani, na kwa adabu.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M3_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "chenji" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Mama alimpa Otieno shilingi mia moja. Otieno alinunua mkate wa shilingi sitini na maziwa ya shilingi thelathini. Muuzaji alimrudishia chenji." Neno "chenji" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: pesa zinazorudishwa baada ya kulipa zaidi

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Mama alimpa Otieno shilingi mia moja. Otieno alinunua mkate wa shilingi sitini na maziwa ya shilingi thelathini. Muuzaji alimrudishia chenji." Neno "chenji" lina maana gani?" with "chupa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "chenji" ni pesa zinazorudishwa baada ya kulipa zaidi.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kuhesabu pesa vizuri tunaponunua bidhaa.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Otieno alinunua mkate." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tunapaswa kuhesabu pesa vizuri tunaponunua bidhaa.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for.

example.question: Otieno atampa mama nini akirudi nyumbani?
example.correct_answer: mkate, maziwa na chenji ya shilingi kumi

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Otieno atampa mama nini akirudi nyumbani?" with "pipi" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za kifungu: mkate, maziwa na chenji ya shilingi kumi
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tuwe waaminifu na tumrudishie mzazi chenji.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Otieno alienda dukani." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tuwe waaminifu na tumrudishie mzazi chenji.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Otieno alipewa shilingi ngapi?" with "Mimi hupewa shilingi hamsini." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: shilingi mia moja
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.error: Writes a list of sentences with no beginning, middle and end.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.cause: The child thinks length makes a story.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.reveals: The question "Kisa kizuri kina sehemu gani?" with "sentensi nyingi tu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.help: Plan on three boxes: mwanzo (who, where), kati (what happened), mwisho (how it ended).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.feedback: Kisa kina mwanzo, kati na mwisho.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.error: Writes no title, or a title that does not fit the writing.

example.question: Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu dukani?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.cause: The child thinks the word "insha" or the date is the title.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.reveals: The question "Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu dukani?" with "Insha" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.help: Read the finished writing and ask: what is it about in three words?
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.feedback: Kichwa kinasema insha inahusu nini: Siku Nilipoenda Dukani.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.error: Joins every sentence with "na halafu", so the writing is one long sentence.

example.question: Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?
example.wrong_answer: Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni.
example.correct_answer: Tuliamka asubuhi. Tulioga, kisha tukaenda sokoni.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.cause: Spoken retelling joins events with na halafu; the child writes as he talks.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.help: Give a word bank: kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe; one per sentence.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.feedback: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.error: Slips from one tense to another in the middle of the writing (past -li- to present -na-, or habitual hu- to past).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.cause: The child thinks of the events as he writes and the tense of the moment comes in.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Jana nilienda dukani. Ninanunua sukari." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.help: Underline every verb; all the tense markers should match.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.feedback: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.error: Puts English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.cause: The child does not know the Kiswahili word and fills the gap with the one he knows.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.reveals: The question "Sahihisha:" with "Nilinunua sugar na bread." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.help: Keep a word bank of theme words on the board before writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili: Nilinunua sukari na mkate.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T7_UANDISHI_WA_INSHA.INSH.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.error: Keeps the final -a in the negative present (hasoma for hasomi).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.cause: The child adds the negative prefix and leaves the rest of the verb as it was.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Yeye anauza sukari." with "Yeye hauza sukari." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.help: Show the pair with the end of the verb circled: anasoma - hasomi.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.feedback: Katika ukanushaji wa wakati uliopo, -a inakuwa -i: hasomi. (Yeye hauzi sukari.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.error: Keeps the tense marker -na- in the negative (hanasomi for hasomi).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.cause: The child negates by adding ha- to the whole positive verb.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Yeye ananunua mkate." with "Yeye hananunui mkate." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.help: Cross out na in the positive form and change the end.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.feedback: Hasomi: hakuna -na- katika ukanushaji huu. (Yeye hanunui mkate.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.error: Negates by putting si before the positive verb (Yeye si anasoma).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.cause: Si is the negative the child knows (si mimi), so he puts it in front of any sentence.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Muuzaji anafungua duka." with "Muuzaji si anafungua duka." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.help: Show si as the negative of ni (Yeye si mwalimu) and ha- as the negative of a verb.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.feedback: Kitendo hukanushwa kwa ha-: Yeye hasomi. (Muuzaji hafungui duka.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.error: Uses the negative prefix of another person (Wao hasomi for hawasomi; Mimi hasomi for sisomi).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.cause: The child learnt one negative form (ha-) and uses it for all persons.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Wao wanauza maziwa." with "Wao hauzi maziwa." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.help: Table of persons: si-, hu-, ha-, hatu-, ham-, hawa-; the child points before writing.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.feedback: Wao hawasomi; mimi sisomi. (Wao hawauzi maziwa.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHAJI_WA_NAFSI_.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "nyama". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /ny/, or do not separate it from /n/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "nyama". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "nama" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Pushes a vowel into the cluster, so "mbwa" is said "mubwa".
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: In the child's first language, or in English loan habits, two consonants rarely sit together; he breaks them with a vowel.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Tamka neno "mbwa". Ni lipi sahihi?" with "mubwa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the cluster in one beat, then the word; clap once for the cluster syllable.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: "mbwa" ina silabi mbwa; hakuna irabu ya ziada.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "ndege" becomes "dege".

example.question: Neno "ndege" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "ndege" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "dege" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "ndege". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Splits "mbweha" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "mbweha" lina silabi zipi?" with "m-b-w-e-h-a" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: mbwe-ha.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /mbw/, /nd/, /ny/?" with "kuku" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "nyumbani" as "numbani".
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "nyumbani" linasomwa vipi?" with "numbani" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Ndege wangu anaimba asubuhi."?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Ndege wangu anaimba asubuhi."?" with "Ndege ... wangu ... anaimba ... asubuhi." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 53 kwa dakika

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umemwona mbwa wa jirani?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umemwona mbwa wa jirani?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "rangi" written "langi".
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "langi" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.help: Keep a list of the class's hard pairs (l/r, s/sh, z/dh, s/th); say each word slowly before writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.feedback: Andika "rangi" kama linavyotamkwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.cause: The n or m before a consonant is soft and quick; the child does not hear it.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "bawa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.help: Hum the nasal before the word (mmm-bwa, nnn-dege).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.error: Writes a long vowel short, so the word changes: "paa" written "pa".

example.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "sehemu ya juu ya nyumba".

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.cause: The child hears the length but does not know it is shown by two letters.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.reveals: The question "Andika neno lenye maana ya "sehemu ya juu ya nyumba"." with "pa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.help: Clap the two vowels as two beats; compare a word with one and two vowels.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.error: Writes ng' without the apostrophe (ngombe for ng'ombe), or puts it where it does not belong (ng'oma for ngoma).

example.question: Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.cause: Ng' and ng are two sounds; the apostrophe looks like dirt on the page to the child.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?" with "ngombe" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.help: Say ng'ombe and ngoma: the first has no g sound; mark it with the apostrophe.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.error: Joins two words into one, or splits one word into two (kwasababu; mwana funzi).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.cause: In speech the words run together; the child has not seen each written apart.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nilichelewa kwasababu ya mvua." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M3_TAH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.error: Uses the people word (huyu, yule) for a thing (kiti huyu).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.cause: Huyu was the first pointing word learnt; the child uses it for anything.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Yai ___ ni bovu." with "huyu" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.help: Point at a child (huyu) and at a chair (hiki); then sort pictures by the pointing word they take.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.feedback: Kitu cha ngeli ya ki-vi huonyeshwa kwa hiki; mtu huonyeshwa kwa huyu. (hili)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.error: Uses the one-thing pointing word with a plural noun (watoto huyu).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.cause: The child changes the noun but not the pointing word.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mayai ___ ni mabovu." with "hili" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.error: Gives a noun of the n-n class a plural prefix (nyumba -> manyumba), or changes an irregular noun wrongly (jicho -> majicho).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.cause: The child expects every plural to look different; n-n nouns stay the same and some li-ma nouns change their stem.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jicho hili" ni?" with "majicho haya" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.help: Keep a short list of the same-in-both nouns (nyumba, ndizi, kalamu) and the irregular ones (jicho - macho, jino - meno).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.feedback: Baadhi ya nomino hazibadiliki, na baadhi hubadilika kwa njia yake. (macho haya)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Jani ___ ni la kijani." with "hii" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (hili)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_H.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Says something that has nothing to do with the topic.

example.question: Mnazungumza kuhusu bidhaa za sokoni. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: The child says what is on his mind; he has not learnt that a conversation has a topic everyone keeps to.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Mnazungumza kuhusu bidhaa za sokoni. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama katuni nzuri." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Put the topic picture in the middle; before speaking the child points to it.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Tunazungumza kuhusu bidhaa za sokoni; sema jambo kuhusu hilo.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Talks over others and does not wait for his turn.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: Eagerness: the child fears he will forget his idea.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Mwenzako anazungumza. Unafanya nini?" with "ninaanza kuzungumza pia" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Pass a talking object (a ball): only the one holding it speaks.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Subiri zamu yako; msikilize mwenzako kwanza.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Mixes English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili sentence.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: At home and in town the child hears mixed speech and does not know the Kiswahili word.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Sema kwa Kiswahili sanifu:" with "Tulienda market tukabuy tomatoes." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Keep a word wall: the English or Sheng word, and its Kiswahili word next to it.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema: Tulienda sokoni tukanunua nyanya.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Uses a gesture or face that does not match the words (smiling while giving sad news).

example.question: Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: The child smiles from shyness or does not link the face to the message.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?" with "tabasamu kubwa" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Say one sentence with three faces; the class picks the face that fits.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Says /l/ for /r/ (or /r/ for /l/) while speaking: "rafiki" becomes "lafiki".
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: Several Kenyan first languages do not separate /l/ and /r/; the home sound carries into Kiswahili.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Tamka vizuri: rafiki" with "lafiki" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Practise the pairs with a mirror: the tongue taps for r, it rests for l.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Tamka "rafiki" kwa /r/: ulimi unagonga mara moja.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "wateja" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Bi. Neema huuza matunda sokoni. Ana maembe, machungwa na mananasi. Wateja wengi hununua matunda yake kwa sababu ni safi na matamu." Neno "wateja" lina maana gani?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Bi. Neema huuza matunda sokoni. Ana maembe, machungwa na mananasi. Wateja wengi hununua matunda yake kwa sababu ni safi na matamu." Neno "wateja" lina maana gani?" with "watoto" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "wateja" ni watu wanaonunua bidhaa.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukiuza bidhaa safi tunapata wateja wengi.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Bi. Neema ana maembe." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tukiuza bidhaa safi tunapata wateja wengi.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha mawingu meusi juu ya soko. Nini kitatokea?
example.correct_answer: Mvua itanyesha na wauzaji watafunika bidhaa zao.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha mawingu meusi juu ya soko. Nini kitatokea?" with "Jua kali litawaka." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Mvua itanyesha na wauzaji watafunika bidhaa zao.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuwa safi na waaminifu katika kazi zetu.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Bi. Neema huuza nini?" with "Mama yangu huuza sukumawiki." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes a list of sentences with no beginning, middle and end.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child thinks length makes a story.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Plan on three boxes: mwanzo (who, where), kati (what happened), mwisho (how it ended).
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Kisa kina mwanzo, kati na mwisho.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes no title, or a title that does not fit the writing.

example.question: Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu sokoni?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu sokoni?" with "Insha" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Read the finished writing and ask: what is it about in three words?
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Kichwa kinasema insha inahusu nini: Safari Yangu ya Sokoni.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Joins every sentence with "na halafu", so the writing is one long sentence.

example.question: Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Give a word bank: kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe; one per sentence.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Slips from one tense to another in the middle of the writing (past -li- to present -na-, or habitual hu- to past).

example.question: Ni lipi sahihi?
example.wrong_answer: Tulifika sokoni mapema. Mama ananunua ndizi.
example.correct_answer: Tulifika sokoni mapema. Mama alinunua ndizi.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child thinks of the events as he writes and the tense of the moment comes in.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Tulifika sokoni mapema. Mama ananunua ndizi." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Underline every verb; all the tense markers should match.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child does not know the Kiswahili word and fills the gap with the one he knows.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Sahihisha:" with "Tulinunua sukuma na onions." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Keep a word bank of theme words on the board before writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili: Tulinunua sukumawiki na vitunguu.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.error: Leaves out ya (juu meza for juu ya meza).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.cause: In fast speech ya is quick and the child does not hear it.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Ndizi ziko juu meza." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.help: Say the phrase slowly with a clap on ya.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.feedback: Tunasema "juu ya meza". (Ndizi ziko juu ya meza.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.error: Uses kwa in place of ya (ndani kwa sanduku).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.cause: Kwa is a common joining word and the child reaches for it.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Machungwa yako ndani kwa kikapu." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.help: Pair cards: juu ya, ndani ya, mbele ya; kwa is not among them.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.feedback: Tunasema "ndani ya sanduku". (Machungwa yako ndani ya kikapu.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.error: Mixes the place words (juu ya for chini ya, mbele ya for nyuma ya).

example.question: Muuzaji amesimama mbele ya kibanda. Yuko wapi?

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.cause: The pairs are learnt together and swapped.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.reveals: The question "Muuzaji amesimama mbele ya kibanda. Yuko wapi?" with "nyuma ya kibanda" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.help: Place a real ball on, under, in, in front of a box; the child says where.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.feedback: Angalia tena mpira ulipo. (mbele ya kibanda)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.error: Adds -ni to the noun as well as ndani ya (ndani ya sandukuni).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.cause: Both ways of saying "in" are known; the child uses both at once.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Pesa ziko ndani ya mfukoni." among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.help: Show the two ways side by side: sandukuni, or ndani ya sanduku; never both.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.feedback: Sema "ndani ya sanduku" au "sandukuni", si vyote viwili. (Pesa ziko ndani ya mfuko.)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T9_YA_JUU_YA.VIHUSISHI.M3.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "nzuri". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /nz/, or do not separate it from /ns/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "nzuri". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "nsuri" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Pushes a vowel into the cluster, so "twiga" is said "tuwiga".
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: In the child's first language, or in English loan habits, two consonants rarely sit together; he breaks them with a vowel.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Tamka neno "twiga". Ni lipi sahihi?" with "tuwiga" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Say the cluster in one beat, then the word; clap once for the cluster syllable.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.feedback: "twiga" ina silabi twi-ga; hakuna irabu ya ziada.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "mbali" becomes "bali".

example.question: Neno "mbali" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Neno "mbali" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "bali" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "mbali". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Splits "mbali" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Neno "mbali" lina silabi zipi?" with "m-b-a-l-i" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: mba-li.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /mb/, /nz/, /tw/?" with "redio" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G3.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "twende" as "tuwende".
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Neno "twende" linasomwa vipi?" with "tuwende" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Mama ana simu mpya ya kisasa."?

example.correct_answer: Mama ana simu mpya ya kisasa.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 55 kwa dakika

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, simu hii ni nzuri?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.

KISW.G3.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.error: Writes no title, or a title that does not fit the writing.

example.question: Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu teknolojia?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.reveals: The question "Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu teknolojia?" with "Insha" among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.help: Read the finished writing and ask: what is it about in three words?

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.error: Joins every sentence with "na halafu", so the writing is one long sentence.

example.question: Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?
example.wrong_answer: Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni.
example.correct_answer: Tuliamka asubuhi. Tulioga, kisha tukaenda sokoni.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.cause: Spoken retelling joins events with na halafu; the child writes as he talks.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.help: Give a word bank: kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe; one per sentence.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.feedback: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.error: Slips from one tense to another in the middle of the writing (past -li- to present -na-, or habitual hu- to past).

example.question: Ni lipi sahihi?
example.wrong_answer: Simu hutumika kuwasiliana. Iliwasaidia watu kuzungumza.
example.correct_answer: Simu hutumika kuwasiliana. Huwasaidia watu kuzungumza.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.cause: The child thinks of the events as he writes and the tense of the moment comes in.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Simu hutumika kuwasiliana. Iliwasaidia watu kuzungumza." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.help: Underline every verb; all the tense markers should match.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.feedback: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.

KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.error: Puts English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.cause: The child does not know the Kiswahili word and fills the gap with the one he knows.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.reveals: The question "Sahihisha:" with "Simu ina screen na battery." among the options.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.help: Keep a word bank of theme words on the board before writing.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili: Simu ina skrini na betri.
KISW.G3.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSH.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives the negative of the verb (hafungui) instead of its opposite action (funga).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: The child thinks "opposite" means "not doing it".
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "washa" (redio) ni?" with "usiwashe" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Act it: fungua the door, then funga it; not doing anything is not the opposite.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.feedback: Kinyume cha kitendo ni kitendo kingine: fungua - funga. (zima)
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Makes an opposite by adding -ua to any verb (keti -> ketua).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: Fungua/funga and vaa/vua show a pattern, and the child uses it everywhere.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "keti" ni?" with "ketua" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Sort pairs into two piles: made with -ua (funga-fungua) and different words (keti-simama).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives a word of the same meaning as the opposite (simama - inuka).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: The child knows the words go together but not that they mean the same.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "simama" ni?" with "inuka" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Act both words: if the action is the same, it is not the opposite.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives a place or thing word as the opposite of an action (ingia - nje).
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: Ingia and nje are heard together in "ingia ndani, toka nje".
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "ingia" ni?" with "nje" among the options.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Ask "Ni kitendo?" before accepting: the opposite of an action is an action.
KISW.G3.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
